name: send
description: Write to a correspondent, reach a focus, or publish to a feed. A correspondence reference confirms the sending service accepted the message for delivery. A focus message enters its recipient's queue and can wake that focus. A feed sequence identifies the stored message.

focus_id.description: Complete ID of an existing focus.

feed_id.description: Complete ID of an open feed.

name: create_feed
description: Create a feed that can outlive this focus and survives restart. Use the returned feed_id to publish and to direct readers to the feed. In an activity, "$IVENNA" feed read --help explains how to read it.

description.description: Briefly describe what readers can expect to find in the feed.

name: close_feed
description: Close a feed to new messages. Published messages remain readable. The result's changed field is true when this call closes the feed.

name: open_focus
description: Open an activity to pursue a task while the core continues. The activity can run host commands and report to the core. The result gives its focus_id.

name: schedule_attention
description: Leave yourself something to return to later by scheduling a wakeup for the core. The wakeup survives restart.

name: subscribe
description: Register this focus for reports that can wake it. Give the returned subscription_id to a listener you set up. In an activity, "$IVENNA" subscription --help lists the listener commands.

listener.description: Describe what the listener watches and when it reports.

name: withdraw_subscription
description: Withdraw any subscription by ID. Accepted reports still reach the subscribing focus. Stop the listener separately if needed.
